description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

About the team:

The Portal Operations Romania team operates and improves infrastructure and services used by millions of WEB.DE, GMX and Mail.com customers.

Our work includes Kubernetes-based platforms, Linux systems, virtualization infrastructure, monitoring and alerting, automation, databases and reliably operating the business-critical services developed in Romania. We closely collaborate with other teams from Romania and Germany.

As a working student, you will work alongside our experienced system engineers and gradually take responsibility for real operational and infra tasks.

About the Working Student program:

This program is intended for students (currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program) who want to gain experience, following what they learned in a specialized faculty, in order to become IT specialists. 

Main responsibilities:

  • Support the deployment and operation of applications on K8S-based platforms as well as virtualized infrastructure.
  • Troubleshooting and administration of Linux systems.
  • Investigate technical issues and incidents together with experienced developers.
  • Automate recurring operational tasks using Bash, Python.
  • Contribute to the development of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and infrastructure configuration.
  • Create, improve and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks.

We appreciate:

  • You are currently enrolled in computer science, IT, engineering, or a similar technical study program.
  • You have a good understanding of operating system concepts and Linux system administration.
  • You have basic knowledge of containerization technologies as well as Kubernetes, and/or you actively show interest in learning these technologies.
  • You approach AI with curiosity and critical thinking, leveraging it in your daily work.
  • You have some experience with Git and at least one scripting/programming language.
  • You enjoy troubleshooting and approaching technical issues in a systematic way.
  • You are curious, willing to learn, and comfortable asking questions when you don’t know.

Would be a plus:

  • You enjoy experimenting with AI-assisted tools and are motivated to adopt new technologies that improve how you learn and work.
  • You understand fundamental networking concepts such as DNS, load balancing, and TCP/IP stack.
  • You have experimented with NoSQL DBs.

What we offer:

  • The chance to use and learn a variety of cool technologies, tools and frameworks and get familiar with product  development responsibility;
  • Guidance and coaching to help you every step of the way;
  • The opportunity to meet and work with experienced professionals;
  • Flexible working hours to accommodate your academic schedule;
  • Support on working on real-world projects and gain hands-on experience;
  • Hybrid work possibility;
  • Potential for future career opportunities within our company;
  • Substitute days off for public holidays that occur on the weekend;
  • Team events, networking events organized to promote a passionate, creative and diverse culture;
  • Summerfest and Winterfest parties;
  • 12.5 vacation days/6 months;
  • Of course, coffee, soft drinks and fresh fruits are on us in the office.

About IONOS

IONOS is the leading European digitalization partner for small and medium-sized businesses (SMB). The company serves around six million customers and operates across 18 markets in Europe and North America, with its services being accessible worldwide. With its Web Presence & Productivity portfolio, IONOS acts as a 'one-stop shop' for all digitalization needs: from domains and web hosting to classic website builders and do-it-yourself solutions, from e-commerce to online marketing tools. In addition, the company offers Cloud Solutions to enterprises who are looking to move to the cloud as their businesses evolve. 

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.
